rationale: No safe floor was found on the sealed development set. The strongest candidate that preserved baseline hit@5 with zero relevant empty responses (0.4627230370852818) rejected 65% of absent queries but only 62.5% of off-domain anchors, below the mandatory 100% anchor criterion. Raising the floor further would trade away known-answer behavior without establishing a defensible separation, so this deployment keeps the md floor unset.
